Astrophysicists confirmed that binary black holes can spiral inward and merge into a single massive remnant. But what if two giant black holes collided right near our galaxy? Their inward spiral would release massive gravitational waves through curving spacetime, merging behind a single event horizon. Imagine looking up and watching two cosmic whirlpools combine into one inescapable void. What if you were drawn toward the central singularity? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: Black holes can spiral inward and merge into a single remnant, astrophysicists confirmed
